edition.title: Morning Edition
edition.dek: PHP security fixes, Sudan's currency slide, Taiwan's storm warning and the costs of technological convenience.

lead_story.headline: PHP vulnerabilities prompt emergency fixes and website shutdowns
lead_story.summary: Two critical PHP flaws triggered October 21 patches and precautionary outages; outages do not prove intrusion.
lead_story.why_it_matters: Common software weaknesses can affect many institutions.

items.headline: Sudan's pound reportedly reaches 10,000 per dollar
items.summary: War and scarce foreign currency have driven a new reported parallel-market low.
items.why_it_matters: Currency collapse raises the price of essential imports.

items.headline: Taiwan issues land warning for Typhoon Champi
items.summary: A storm expected to veer away could still bring dangerous rain and seas Friday and Saturday.
items.why_it_matters: Rainfall risk does not depend solely on landfall.

items.headline: EU investigates Booking.com over fraud safeguards
items.summary: Formal proceedings concern fake listings, phishing and paid-placement disclosure; no violation is established.
items.why_it_matters: Platform risk management is under regulatory scrutiny.

items.headline: Older catch-up: EU plans data-centre efficiency labels
items.summary: A September 21 proposal would rate energy and water efficiency, not cap total use.
items.why_it_matters: Digital infrastructure's resource costs may become more visible.

items.headline: A dark-flowered bromeliad is named in Peru
items.summary: Puya ukumari grows near Manu and has near-black blue petals; its endangered assessment is preliminary.
items.why_it_matters: Fieldwork continues to reveal overlooked biodiversity.

items.headline: Caral valley students prepare festival art
items.summary: A local preview describes student drawing and clay contests ahead of October 23–24 crafts and music.
items.why_it_matters: A modest glimpse of ordinary community life.

items.headline: Does technology deskill its users?
items.summary: Melanie Challenger argues that replacing navigation, attention and writing practice may erode embodied skills.
items.why_it_matters: The distinction between augmentation and substitution matters.

worth_your_time.headline: Europe's last integrated penicillin plant faces price pressure
worth_your_time.summary: Reuters examines Sandoz's Austrian factory and competition from cheap Chinese antibiotic ingredients.
worth_your_time.why_it_matters: Cheap procurement can conflict with resilient medicine supplies.

https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacif.headline: PHP vulnerabilities prompt emergency fixes and website shutdowns
body: PHP developers released security patches for two critical flaws October 21; exposed applications may face remote code execution risks.
CERT-EU advised isolating services if patching was impossible. A precautionary shutdown is not proof of a successful attack.
Shared software creates common risks across public services and businesses.
https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacif.uncertainty: The number of actual compromises is unknown.

https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sud.headline: Sudan's pound reportedly reaches 10,000 per dollar
body: Reuters quotes a parallel-market rate around 10,000 pounds per dollar, distinct from the official exchange rate.
War has damaged production and gold exports. Sudan Tribune reported an earlier slide to 8,800 in October.
Foreign-currency scarcity raises the cost of imported food, fuel and medicine.
https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sud.background: War since 2023 has fractured Sudan's economy.
https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sud.uncertainty: The exact new rate lacks independent local confirmation.

https://focustaiwan.tw/society/202610220.headline: Taiwan issues land warning for Typhoon Champi
body: Taiwan's weather agency issued a land warning October 22.
Local forecasts expect strong rain Friday and Saturday, particularly in northern and eastern mountains.
The typhoon's broad circulation may be dangerous without a direct strike.
https://focustaiwan.tw/society/202610220.uncertainty: Track and rainfall forecasts remain changeable.

https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1021/159626.headline: EU investigates Booking.com over fraud safeguards
body: The Commission opened proceedings over fraudulent listings, phishing and boosted search placement.
Booking.com says it is cooperating; the investigation is not a finding of wrongdoing.
The DSA requires large platforms to assess systemic risks, not merely remove reported scams.
https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1021/159626.background: Paid rankings and account impersonation can mislead travelers.
https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1021/159626.uncertainty: Allegations are unproven and EU-wide complaint evidence is incomplete.

https://www.reuters.com/business/environ.headline: Older catch-up: EU plans data-centre efficiency labels
body: The September proposal introduces common ratings for larger data centres.
Labels would address energy, water and waste-heat reuse; separate rules may later impose minimum standards.
Efficiency improvements do not guarantee lower total consumption if capacity grows.
https://www.reuters.com/business/environ.background: AI infrastructure expansion increases grid and water demand.
https://www.reuters.com/business/environ.uncertainty: The proposal is subject to scrutiny and is not a consumption cap.

https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-extrao.headline: A dark-flowered bromeliad is named in Peru
body: Botanists described Puya ukumari, a bromeliad with unusually dark petals, near Manu.
Its name refers to the Andean bear, whose feeding habits helped guide field observations.
The limited known range prompted a preliminary endangered assessment.
https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-extrao.background: Cloud forests are still incompletely surveyed.
https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-extrao.uncertainty: The taxonomic paper DOI was not independently retrieved.

https://aeon.co/essays/the-more-we-rely-.headline: Does technology deskill its users?
body: Challenger asks whether efficient tools can weaken capacities developed through repeated embodied practice.
Her argument: perception and action build skill; substitution reduces practice; lost practice may erode independent agency.
Consider GPS: learning landmarks while checking a map differs from blindly following every instruction. This is an illustration, not a controlled experiment.
A strong objection is that outsourcing and assistive technologies often increase freedom. A plausible reply distinguishes augmentation from replacement.
The essay's claims about machine intelligence remain disputed philosophical positions, not settled experimental findings.
https://aeon.co/essays/the-more-we-rely-.background: Embodied cognition links thought with action and bodily feedback.
https://aeon.co/essays/the-more-we-rely-.uncertainty: Evidence from particular tasks does not establish a universal effect of automation.

https://www.reuters.com/business/healthc.headline: Europe's last integrated penicillin plant faces price pressure
body: Reuters reports from Sandoz's Kundl factory, Europe's last integrated penicillin production site.
Austrian ORF documented company concerns about low-price competition but no announced factory closure.
The EU's Critical Medicines Act addresses supply resilience, while paying for redundant capacity has costs.
https://www.reuters.com/business/healthc.background: Essential generic antibiotics face thin margins and concentrated supply chains.
https://www.reuters.com/business/healthc.uncertainty: Claims of dumping or unfair subsidies have not been adjudicated.
